children: Wednesday it may proactively shut off power to large areas of its northern California territory this week due to the elevated risk of fire following an extended heat wave and hot, dry winds.
The potential Public Safety Power Shutoffs, starting Wednesday evening and forecast to last through Saturday afternoon, could affect ~70K customers across 29 counties, the utility said.
Dry conditions and 20-40 mph winds are forecast across the area on Thursday and Friday, raising the risk that wildfires spread rapidly, the National Weather Service reported.
Further south, a fire weather watch was posted for Los Angeles and Ventura counties and surrounding areas as Santa Ana winds sweep through Thursday and Friday, the NWS said.

title: PG&E says fire conditions threaten power shutoffs this week across northern California
